planets.name: G 9-40 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of G 9-40 with a 5.75-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: G 9-40 b was found in 2019 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around G 9-40. Its orbit and size follow Luque et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname LUQUE_ET_AL__2022): disc_year 2019, disc_facility K2, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 5.7459982, pl_radj 0.16950694, pl_bmassj 0.01258541

quotes.title: G 9-40 b
quotes.card: G 9-40 b is a sub-Neptune exoplanet that has an orbital period of 5.7 days.
quotes.introduction: The host star is a red dwarf located in the constellation Cancer 91 light-years away from Earth.
